# RewardSplitter

<!-- generated by scripts/render.mjs from data/ ; do not edit -->

Splits purchaser rewards three ways: treasury, shared upside, and the application. All shares stay in RewardVault custody as pot attributions: the recipient pulls its own pot whenever it chooses (`RewardVault.transfer`) or migrates it onward, so delivery imposes no requirement on the recipient beyond pot ownership.

**Address**: [`0x4d7BE30350C94487c33b43c2462767679dcCC15d`](https://evm.now/address/0x4d7BE30350C94487c33b43c2462767679dcCC15d?chainId=1)
**Source**: `src/midway/RewardSplitter.sol`

## Functions

### State changing

| Function | Notice |
| --- | --- |
| `setSplit(uint16,uint16)` | Set the treasury and shared-upside shares together, so the pair stays consistent. Registry operator only; bounded by `MAX_TREASURY_BPS` and `MAX_SKIM_BPS`. |
| `setTreasury(address)` | Set the treasury pot address. Registry operator only; nonzero. |
| `split(uint256,address,uint256)` |  |

### View

| Function | Notice |
| --- | --- |
| `MAX_SKIM_BPS()` | Ceiling on the shared-upside share, a fat-finger guard on an economic lever. |
| `MAX_TREASURY_BPS()` | Ceiling on the treasury share, a fat-finger guard on an economic lever. |
| `midwayBuyer()` |  |
| `registry()` |  |
| `rewardVault()` |  |
| `sharedUpside()` |  |
| `skimBps()` | Shared-upside share of gross rewards, in bps. Set at construction; mutable by the registry operator afterward via `setSplit`. Applies to `split` calls after the change, never retroactively. |
| `skimCarry(uint256)` |  |
| `splitterId()` |  |
| `treasury()` | Treasury pot address in RewardVault. Mutable by the registry operator; applies to `split` calls after the change. FWAT already attributed to the prior address stays in that pot; moving it onward is the prior treasury's own call. |
| `treasuryBps()` | Treasury share of gross rewards, in bps. Set at construction; mutable by the registry operator afterward via `setSplit`. Applies to `split` calls after the change, never retroactively. |
| `treasuryCarry(uint256)` |  |
